2: axis tick / combo digits of the Qt viewer
blur: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
cividis: colormap menu entry of the Qt ImageView; not offered by the shared emtk ImageCanvas (report: more colormaps).
divide: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
frame: Qt ImageView frame/time label of the normalisation
gray: present in emtk's list (only shown when it is opened)
inferno: present in emtk's list (only shown when it is opened)
mean: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
operation: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation (Operation: subtract/divide/blur of a frame range); display tool, not part of the analysis.
roi: pyqtgraph ImageView ROI button: a line-profile ROI of the viewer; the emtk image has no ROI (the Detectors and the maps are the tool's function).
subtract: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
t: Qt ImageView axis label (frame index); the emtk movie has Play, Loop, Stop and a frame slider
timerange: Qt ImageView time-range widgets of its normalisation
viridis: Colormap names inside the Qt image's colormap menu; emtk offers magma, inferno, viridis and gray in the shared ImageCanvas (shared chisurf/emtk, not editable here).
x: axis letters of the Qt viewer; emtk draws 'x [px]' and 'y [px]'
y: axis letters of the Qt viewer; emtk draws 'x [px]' and 'y [px]'
